Consolidated revenue came in at about Rs.54,000 crores, growing 3.5% sequentially.
Africa maintained its trajectory of solid performance with constant currency revenue growth of 5.8%.

reported.metric: India excluding passive infra sequential growth
reported.quote: India excluding passive infra grew at 2.1% sequentially.
Consolidated EBITDAaL came in at over Rs.27,700 crores, a growth of 4.2%.
Our EBITDAaL margin stood at 51.3%, which is about 30 basis points improvement sequentially.
Operating free cash flow which is EBITDAaL minus capex was a strong Rs.15,900 crores.
Capex for the quarter was about Rs.11,800 crores.
India EBITDAaL, excluding passive infra, came in at over Rs.18,450 crores, growing at 2.8% sequentially.
EBITDAaL margin stood at 51.8%, again a 30 basis points improvement.
Capex for the quarter was at about Rs.7,100 crores.
Our consolidated net debt to EBITDAaL improved to 1.02 with India now at 1.38.
ARPU came in at Rs.259, led by our continued efforts on premiumizing and improving our portfolio mix.
